programmes.programName: Ph.D. in Quality, Reliability and Operations Research
programmes.department: Statistical Quality Control and Operations Research Division
programmes.evidence: Current official SQC and OR Division names Quality, Reliability and Operations Research as a Ph.D. discipline. The institute's complete Research Programmes I list confirms this is one of exactly five ISI-awarded Ph.D. disciplines; original programme check date retained.
limitations: One institute-awarded QROR doctorate across locations, not separate Quality, Reliability and OR awards.

branches.conclusion: The institute's full current Research Programmes I inventory names exactly five ISI-awarded Ph.D. disciplines: Statistics, Mathematics, Quantitative Economics, Computer Science and QROR. Its academic divisional list names Social Sciences and Quantitative Economics but no separate business school. No additional formally titled Operations/Management Science/Industrial Engineering Ph.D. in a business branch is listed. Research Programmes II require registration with another awarding university and are not duplicate ISI awards.

Full current institute Research Programmes I and II inventory and 2026 admissions examination-programme list read. Only QROR among five ISI-awarded disciplines has exact qualifying title. Statistics, Mathematics, Quantitative Economics and Computer Science are distinct broad disciplines; no other named Operations/Management Science/Industrial Engineering formal doctorate appears. Research Programmes II fellows must obtain doctorates from other universities and cannot be counted as independent ISI awards. This is a bounded named-discipline conclusion, not an assertion about every research topic within the other four disciplines.
